items.title: Al Gallodoro Interview, 1966-05-10
items.q: Matter of fact, Howard sold me the first one. You remember? I bought the metal, the silver clarinet.

ctx.x: Could you name some of those in the story?

Yeah, I'm trying to think of one big movie we made with Mel Ferrer. Lost Boundaries. Hey, Howard. How you doing? Great, man. Have you seen Lost Boundaries? No, I haven't seen that. Once in a while. Well, it had to do with this family up in New England that were half colored, you know, and they were passing as white. So, it's a very good story. Nothing wrong with it. But the score was very good. I did quite a bit of alto work and clarinet and bass clarinet. You hear it here and there. You know, they show Harlem…
When did you start working with Sylvia? You are a clarinet.
